delivery.description: The delivery ULID. Matches X-Tmesis-Delivery. Duplicated in the body so a receiver that logs bodies has the dedupe key without the headers.

occurred_at.description: RFC3339 UTC, when the event happened on the node. ORDER BY THIS, never by arrival: delivery is unordered.

reason.description: CLOSED set. benchmark: the stored measurements at boot (live and jobs). encoder: a pinned encoder at boot, with its usable flag. admission: the units ledger filled or cleared (only while admission is on). device: the encoder session ceiling filled (no room for one more session of the unit ladder) or cleared.

full.description: admission and device: true when the ledger filled, false when it has stayed below its limit for the 30 s hold-down. Null for benchmark and encoder.

live_capacity.description: The health live_capacity object. On admission and device the transition's own used and limit, never a later reading.

jobs_capacity.description: The job slots and their source. Null when jobs are off.

video_engine.description: The live ladder's encoder, as on node.online. Null on a node that encodes no live stream.

jobs_video_engine.description: The VOD job encoder, as on node.online. Null when jobs are off.

previous.description: The prior value of each live_capacity field that changed since the last event of this reason from this process. Null for benchmark and encoder, and for the first event of a reason.

source.description: CLOSED set. configured: jobs.max_concurrent. measured: the stored job measurement valid for this box. unmeasured and stale run one job.

admission.description: CLOSED set. Live unit admission: on refuses past encode_slots_total; off admits and still counts (unmeasured, stale or insufficient); not_applicable is a node that does not encode live (passthrough or transcoder).

source.description: CLOSED set. Where the limits came from: the stored measurement valid for this box, a told limits.max_streams, none, a record of another box, a record that found the box cannot hold one session; not_applicable with admission not_applicable.

unit_ladder.description: The ladder one unit is one session of: the stored record's, else encode.default_ladder; empty when not applicable.

encode_slots_total.description: The unit limit. Null whenever admission is not on, never 0 as a stand-in for unknown.

encode_slots_used.description: Units held by live sessions, counted whether or not admission is on.

device_sessions_total.description: The NVENC/QSV encoder session ceiling of a stored record that matches this box. Null when no ceiling is known.

device_sessions_used.description: Encoder sessions held on the device: live sessions plus running job encoders.

measured_at.description: When the stored record was measured, stale ones included. Null when no record was read.

encoder.description: The ffmpeg encoder the workload is built with; under a failed pin, the pin.

usable.description: False only for a pin that failed at boot: the workload is refused until it is repaired or set to auto and tmesis restarts.
